description: Fix the DTO system so that when a transfer model has a custom __schema_name__ defined, only the root-level model uses that custom name in OpenAPI schemas. Currently, nested child models incorrectly inherit the parent's custom schema name in their $ref references instead of using their own schema names.
functional_requirements: Modify the DTO backend to track whether a transfer model is the root model or a nested child model
Apply the custom __schema_name__ only to root-level transfer models in OpenAPI schema generation
Ensure nested child models continue to use their default schema names in $ref references
